Description

This specification document summarises the APIs that YAMAHA ➡ MES.
The following APIs are supported.
| Event Name | Description | |------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | MchStatusReport | Reportss machine status updates (e.g., INIT, RESET, STOP, RUN, etc.) | | PCBEntryEvent *1 | Verifies PCB production permission from MES, shows error if denied | | PcbExitEvent | Reports production history (mount log) of each PCB | | MaterialRequest *1 | Verifies reel ID and requests usage permission and part info from MES, shows error if denied | | CmpStatusReport | Reports current material usage information in real-time | | DetectedPartsKnotReport | Reports reel-parts are switched (splicing detected) | | SetupRequest *1 | Verifies operator setup for parts (e.g., trolley, magazine, feeder), shows error if denied | | SetupRemoved | Reports oprator un-setup for parts (e.g., trolley, magazine,feeder) | | PgmSwitched | Reports the production program is switched | | MaintenanceReport | Reports maintenance warnings or stop signals (e.g., feeder usage limits) | | SensorPartsRemainCorrectionReport | Reports reel quantity correction based on splicing sensor detection | *1 require a response from MES.

Note

When sending request to REST-MES Server, please note the following points: - Ensure that your MES is registered in the RestComm Output Module before executing any API request. - Select the appropriate authentication type: either Basic or None, as required. - Include the client-name in the request header, matching the name of your Relay Instance registered in the RestComm Output Module.
